title: calliandra houstoniana subsp. alamosensis
intro: Calliandra houstoniana subsp. alamosensis, commonly known as Powderpuff, is a flowering plant species in the Fabaceae family. This plant is known for its vibrant pink to red powderpuff-like flowers, which are borne on long staminal columns. The health benefits of Calliandra houstoniana subsp. alamosensis include its use as a diuretic and in treating urinary disorders, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
